title: Nicholas Boggs receives 2026 Truman Capote Award from UI
summary_en: Nicholas Boggs, a writer and assistant professor of English and creative writing at Stony Brook University in Stony Brook, New York, has been selected as the 2026 recipient of the Truman Capote Literary Trust Award for Literary Criticism in Memory of Newton Arvin.
title_cn: Nicholas Boggs receives 2026 Truman Capote Award from UI

title: Iowa Writers’ Workshop alumna named finalist for National Book Award
summary_en: Poet Brenda Hillman, who earned an MFA from the University of Iowa Writers’ Workshop in 1976, is a 2026 finalist for the prestigious National Book Award.
title_cn: Iowa Writers’ Workshop alumna named finalist for National Book Award
